### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications across all three files are related in that they address the same underlying issue regarding alignment checks. The change from checking the address offset (`a + lda`) to checking the product of `lda` and the size of the data type (`lda * sizeof(double)`) is a unified approach to ensure that the optimized code only runs when it is safe to do so. This change was prompted by a bug identified in a previous fix (commit `25b258d`), and the updates across the files reflect a coordinated effort to correct this alignment check consistently in multiple functions that rely on similar logic.
